val [includeThoughts](include-thoughts.html): [Boolean](https://kotlinlang.org/api/latest/jvm/stdlib/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-boolean/index.html)? = null

Indicates whether to include thoughts in the response. If true, thoughts are returned only if the model supports thought and thoughts are available.

val [thinkingBudget](thinking-budget.html): [Int](https://kotlinlang.org/api/latest/jvm/stdlib/kotlin-stdlib/kotlin/-int/index.html)? = null

Indicates the thinking budget in tokens. 0 is DISABLED. -1 is AUTOMATIC. The default values and allowed ranges are model dependent.

[thinkingLevel](thinking-level.html)

Link copied to clipboard

val [thinkingLevel](thinking-level.html): [ThinkingLevel](../-thinking-level/index.html)? = null

Controls the maximum depth of the model's internal reasoning process before it produces a response. If not specified, the default is HIGH. Recommended for Gemini 3 or later models. Use with earlier models results in an error.
